$comment: Golden cases for the workbook definition envelope, shared BYTE-IDENTICALLY by the add-in's
Vitest suite and the gateway module's kotest suite.
The add-in writes this into a workbook's custom XML part; Apache POI reads it back on the
gateway when a schedule fires, with no Excel running. The two never meet, so nothing catches
a disagreement about the exact bytes except this file.
`encoded` is what encode(json) must produce, character for character. Every case must also

cases.name: a payload containing the CDATA terminator is split across two sections
cases.note: A tag named foo]]>bar is absurd but possible, and a naive encoder closes the section early and silently truncates the rest — a corrupt workbook rather than an error.

cases.name: XML metacharacters pass through untouched inside CDATA
cases.note: The point of CDATA: no entity escaping, so the JSON is byte-identical on both sides.
